messages.subject: Re: Issue with numericInput
parts:
You've created a preferences reactive expression for the sole purpose of setting a "score" variable. You don't want to do that (basically ever); instead, rename the preferences reactive "score" instead, and just have it return input$Cost*x. A properly written reactive expression is interesting for the value it returns, and nothing else--no side effects.

Secondly, if you create a reactive expression and don't call it from anywhere, it's just as useless as if you create a function and don't call it from anywhere. You want to cbind(college, score()), but do it inside of renderDataTable, not directly inside the function(input,output). If you have it directly inside the function, it won't ever re-execute as the value of score() changes--and in fact since this is such a common mistake for Shiny beginners, we actually throw an error if you try to read a reactive expression outside of either an output renderer, a reactive expression, or an observer.

Final code should look like this:

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  score = reactive ({
    if (input$Outstate == TRUE) {
      diff = input$FundsAvailable - college$Out.of.state.tuition
    }
    else {
      diff = input$FundsAvailable - college$In.state.tuition
    }
    x = ifelse(diff <= -20000, 10, ifelse(diff <= -10000, 8, ifelse(diff <= 0, 6,0)))
    input$Cost * x
  })
  output$school = renderDataTable({
    college = cbind(college, score())
    ...

On Sat, Nov 8, 2014 at 9:39 PM, Kamal <krishna...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

I have a dataset of a list of colleges and I'm trying to assign weights based off of user inputs from the user and then calculate the score.  I'm able to calculate the score successfully and add it to my table, but if I try and weigh the function with the user inputs, the result is zero.  Is there anyway to fix this?  Below is the relevant code.  I didn't the code that's not used in the calculation, as it's a bit long, but if you would like to see it, let me know.

server.R

library(shiny)
college = read.csv("college.csv")
  
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  preferences = reactive ({
    if (input$Outstate == TRUE) {
    diff = input$FundsAvailable - college$Out.of.state.tuition
    }
    else {
      diff = input$FundsAvailable - college$In.state.tuition
    }
    x = ifelse(diff <= -20000, 10, ifelse(diff <= -10000, 8, ifelse(diff <= 0, 6,0)))
    score = input$Cost * x
  })
  college = cbind(college, score)
  college
  output$school = renderDataTable({
    college = college[college$Average.GPA >= input$GPA[1] & college$Average.GPA <= input$GPA[2],]
    college = college[college$Average.SAT.Score >= input$SAT[1] & college$Average.SAT.Score <= input$SAT[2],]
    college = college[college$Average.ACT.Score >= input$ACT[1] & college$Average.ACT.Score <= input$ACT[2],]
    college = college[college$Total.enrollment >= input$Enrollment[1] & college$Total.enrollment <= input$Enrollment[2],]
    college = college[college$Percent.admitted >= input$Acceptance[1] & college$Percent.admitted <= input$Acceptance[2],]
    college = college[college$Percent.of.students.receiving.scholarships >= input$Scholarships[1] & college$Percent.of.students.receiving.scholarships <= input$Scholarships[2],]
    if (input$Type != 'All') {
      college = college[college$Institution.Type == input$Type,]
    }
    if (input$State != 'USA') {
      college = college[college$State == input$State,]
    }
    if (input$Campus != 'Any') {
      college = college[college$Campus == input$Campus,]
    }
    if (input$Outstate == TRUE) {
      college = college[college$Out.of.state.tuition >= input$Tuition[1] & college$Out.of.state.tuition <= input$Tuition[2],]
    }
    else {
      college = college[college$In.state.tuition >= input$Tuition[1] & college$In.state.tuition <= input$Tuition[2],]
    }
    
    college
    
  }
  
  
  )
  output$value <- renderPrint({
    if (input$Academics + input$Cost > 1) {
      print('Error:  Weights Exceed 1')
    }
    else if (input$Academics + input$Cost < 1) {
      print('Error: Weights are less than 1')
    }
    else {
      print('Go on to the next screen')
    }
})})
